daily_summary.html:
Domestic Politics

President Prabowo has ordered forest fire suspects from Riau to be brought to Jakarta for questioning after they were caught pretending to be fishing. The President also reaffirmed a strict ban on land burning across Indonesia, while ordering the construction of wells and canals in peatlands to combat wildfires. Separately, Prabowo dismissed Aceh Regional Secretary M Nasir through a presidential decree with a replacement already prepared.

  • The Forestry Minister deployed 5,000 civil servants to forest fire areas, with echelon I officials to work from the field locations.
  • The Home Affairs Minister emphasized the importance of local government roles down to the village level in preventing forest fires.
  • PDIP chairwoman Megawati broke into tears when Sukarno's face and voice appeared at Gelora Bung Tomo stadium, while separately urging party cadres in NTT to stay strong and support earthquake victims.
  • The Cabinet Secretary stated the President's instructions were clear that disaster logistics must truly reach affected communities.
  • A labor coalition requested a labor desk provision be included in legislation, fearing changes when a new National Police chief is appointed.
  • Police requested a suspension of transactions on a donation account linked to the August 27 demonstration, stating it cannot be a private account, and summoned activist Mas Botok and OJK to investigate fund flows.
  • A DPR legislator called on the National Police to follow environmental laws in handling 72 forest fire suspects.

Foreign Policy & Defence

The Italian aircraft carrier Garibaldi is scheduled to arrive in Indonesia next month and will be renamed KRI Gajah Mada. Indonesia and Uruguay are seeking to strengthen agricultural ties between the two countries. China and Indonesia will focus cooperation on artificial intelligence and maritime sectors.

  • The Air Force confirmed all crew were safe after a Sukhoi jet went off the runway at Hasanuddin Air Base in South Sulawesi.
  • An Indonesian official stated that neighboring countries' responses to forest fires via ASEAN respect Indonesia's sovereignty.
  • Indonesia has issued 35 permits for foreign firefighting aircraft to assist in combating wildfires.

Other

The death toll from the East Nusa Tenggara earthquake has risen to 100, with BNPB reporting 1,603 injured. The Education Ministry provided Rp860 million to earthquake-affected schools in NTT, while Prananda Prabowo handed over Rp545 million for NTT earthquake victims from proceeds of the Soekarno Cup.

  • The KPK searched six locations related to corruption by the Unsoed rector, with a high school teacher allegedly acting as a recruiter of prospective students while campus officials received Rp1.12 billion.
  • Indonesia is targeting 30 companies over forest fires and seeking fines, while also probing 11 companies over fires in South Kalimantan.
  • The Jakarta LRT Kelapa Gading-Manggarai line has been completed with trial runs underway.
  • PT DSI's export platform will be launched on September 1.
  • The government has readied a four-phase recovery plan for fire-ravaged Sade Village, with a task force formed to restore the cultural site and the TNI setting up a field kitchen for victims.
